title: subscription invocation request, v0
description: POST /v0/contributions/subscription, since Plugin API 0.2. One Record Version's text Parts and a batch of distinct evaluations to decide. The core deduplicates Subscriptions that share the same expression and configuration into one evaluation and never sends more evaluations than the manifest's max_batch_size.

invocation_id.description: Unique per attempt; correlate logs with it.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque, stable across retries of the same logical invocation. The same key must yield the same decisions and evidence.

enriched.description: True when the Version has embedding coverage in the active generation. A rule that needs enrichment answers not_ready while it is false; the core evaluates again after enrichment.

parts.description: The canonical text Parts of the Version, in Manifest order. Blob Parts are not sent. Keys are unique.

evaluations.description: Distinct evaluations to decide, each answered by exactly one decision with the same id.

expression.description: The pinned Saved Query Version expression, valid against the manifest's expression_schema.

configuration.description: The pinned Subscription evaluator configuration, valid against the manifest's configuration_schema.

subscriptions.description: The Subscription Versions this evaluation stands for. Informational (logs, tracing): a decision must depend only on the record, the expression and the configurations.

configuration.description: The validated plugin (installer) configuration, as for every Contribution.
